q: When in a shoot should I record the grey card?
a: A few seconds at the start of each set-up (each new light or camera setting), held in the subject's light. Later the white-balance picker (`grade.wb.pick`) on that frame balances the set-up exactly.

q: What gives lifted blacks away in night footage?
a: Noise: lifted blacks in high-ISO night footage fill with it. Keep blacks deep and use temporal noise reduction on the clip.
